response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer (15+ years) with strong craftsmanship, CI/CD, and full-stack skills, and has recent (since April 2025) exposure to MCP tooling and agentic infrastructure. However, he lacks the core requirement of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions, has no demonstrated experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, or major cloud AI platforms, and his skill list does not include Python. His background is strong for general staff-level engineering but does not match the GenAI/cloud specialization and customer-facing technical discovery focus required for this role.
strengths: 15+ years of senior/staff-level software engineering across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Recent hands-on experience with MCP code generators and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Strong engineering culture background (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, open source leadership)
concerns: No evidence of 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions as required
No mention of Python, RAG, vector databases, or LangGraph/CrewAI-style multi-agent frameworks
Limited demonstrated experience in customer-facing technical discovery or major cloud AI platform architecture

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/GenAI domain depth (RAG, vector DBs, multi-agent frameworks)
Missing Python and formal cloud AI platform experience
Recent MCP/agentic tooling exposure and strong generalist engineering pedigree
